g.text: DOGFOOD 2026: MASTER PLATFORM BLUEPRINT & WORKLOAD SPLIT
Self-Hostable Hackathon Judging Platform • 72-Hour Delivery Plan • 100% Offline Single-Container Runtime
Browser Users (Visitor, Participant, Judge, Org) | Acceptance Runner (run.py HTTP probes)
SECURITY & RBAC MIDDLEWARE (THE CRITICAL ISOLATION CORE)
• Token/Cookie Session Validator (org_*, jdg_*, prt_*) • Deadline Enforcer (Refuses submissions past cutoff)
• Peer Score Guard: Checks request.user.id == target_judge_id. REFUSES PEER PEEKING WITH 403 FORBIDDEN
Embedded SQLite DB (Single file, 0 cloud deps)
Auto-prints session cookies on docker boot

3. TEAM WORKLOAD ALLOCATION (TEAM OF 3: 1 LEAD HEAVY LIFTER + 2 FOCUSED SPECIALISTS)
1. Core Framework & Schema: FastAPI app setup, SQLite DB,
models (Event, Track, User, Team, Project, Score, Rubric).
2. RBAC & Auth Isolation Middleware: Cookie session parser,
role enforcement (Visitor, Participant, Judge, Organizer, Admin).
Strict peer-access check: refuse Judge B on Judge A data (403).
3. Deadline Enforcement Guard: Check project submission
Zero cloud dependencies, starts in <10s, auto-runs seeder.
run python3 run.py, verify 7 PASSES, save acceptance-report.txt.
6. Integration & Repo Lead: Git branches, PR merges, final cut.
KEY DELIVERABLES: Backend Engine, Docker, run.py 7/7 PASS
1. Public Project Gallery (/projects): Beautiful card grid
displaying fixture projects (titles, tracks, teams, summaries).
Instant search bar & track filtering dropdown.
2. Project Submission & Draft UI (/projects/new): Form for title,
summary, track, repo URL; displays clear "Event Closed" banner.
3. Judge Scoring Workspace (/judge/scoring): Clean rubric view
with weighted sliders (1-5), comment box, and saved state.
tracks overview, review completion tracker, one-click CSV download.
5. Styling & Assets: Standalone CSS (no external CDN dependence),
sleek dark mode, responsive layout for desktop/laptop.
KEY DELIVERABLES: Gallery, Submission Form, Judge & Org UIs
1. Fixtures Ingestion (seed.py): Parse fixtures.json and populate
SQLite DB; print seed test tokens for .dogfood.toml.
z-score normalization across judges; handle zero-variance edge cases
(e.g., judge who gave every project identical scores).
3. CSV Export Module (/api/export.csv): Generate valid CSV
with headers: project_id, title, raw_avg, normalized_score, rank.
4. Mandated Spec Documents: Write JUDGING.md (defend math),
5. Demo Video Production: Script & record the 5-min lifecycle video
(Create event -> Submit project -> Judge scoring -> Results & CSV).
KEY DELIVERABLES: seed.py, Normalization Math, Docs, Demo Video

• P1: Docker testing with network off
